clients.label: Claude Code
clients.note: Add `--scope user` to make it available in every project.
clients.snippet:
# Run once in your terminal:
claude mcp add iran-bourse -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp iran-bourse-mcp

# Note: Add `--scope user` to make it available in every project.

clients.label: Claude Desktop
clients.note: Restart Claude Desktop after editing the file.

clients.label: OpenAI Codex CLI
clients.snippet:
# Run once in your terminal:
codex mcp add iran-bourse -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp iran-bourse-mcp

# or add to ~/.codex/config.toml:
[mcp_servers.iran-bourse]
command = "uvx"
args = ["--from", "git+https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp", "iran-bourse-mcp"]

clients.label: Cursor
clients.note: Restart Cursor after editing. A one-click install link is available (see `config cursor`).

clients.label: VS Code (GitHub Copilot)
clients.note: Project-level file. Top-level key is `servers`, not `mcpServers`.

clients.label: Windsurf
clients.note: Newer releases may relocate the file; open it from Cascade's MCP panel if this path is missing.

clients.label: Cline
clients.note: Open the MCP Servers panel, choose *Configure MCP Servers*, and paste the entry into the JSON it opens.

clients.label: Roo Code
clients.note: Project file shown; the global file is opened from the MCP settings view.

clients.label: JetBrains AI Assistant
clients.note: Settings > Tools > AI Assistant > Model Context Protocol (MCP) > Add, then paste the JSON.

clients.label: Zed
clients.note: Older Zed versions expect `command` as an object: {"path": ..., "args": [...]}.

clients.label: OpenCode
clients.note: OpenCode uses `command` as one array and `type: local`.

clients.label: Goose
clients.note: Or run `goose configure` > Add Extension > Command-line Extension and enter the command below.
clients.snippet:
# One-click link:
goose://extension?cmd=uvx&arg=--from&arg=git%2Bhttps%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fmsmahdinejad%2Firan-bourse-mcp&arg=iran-bourse-mcp&id=iran-bourse&name=Iran%20Bourse&description=Tehran%20Stock%20Exchange%20and%20Codal%20data

# or in `goose configure`, use this command:
uvx --from git+https://github.com/msmahdinejad/iran-bourse-mcp iran-bourse-mcp

# Note: Or run `goose configure` > Add Extension > Command-line Extension and enter the command below.
